articles.author: Shelby Talcott
articles.summary: Trump administration officials hope that a new press secretary will be named by the “end of year,” as one adviser told Semafor. President Donald Trump has been without a press secretary since Karoline Leavitt departed months ago, barring a five-day stint from Katie Zacharia. He has a few names in mind for the role, as Semafor previously reported, with conservative commentator Ben Ferguson among those under consideration. White House chief of staff Stephen Miller and Leavitt are helping push the search along. articles.title: UK and EU to sign deal aimed at resetting relations
articles.author: Prashant Rao
articles.summary: London and Brussels are poised to sign a deal aimed at resetting relations still blighted by the UK’s vote to exit the EU a decade ago. The limited agreement would allow increased food and drinks trade, a re-linking of their carbon markets, and closer migration cooperation. But the details mask a potentially grander ambition: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said he hopes Britain will rejoin the bloc in his lifetime , and the country is seeing a revived debate on the benefits and costs of membership . Brussels would probably be welcoming, but equally is unwilling to make major concessions. “We didn’t want them to leave,” one European diplomat told Politico. “ They broke up with us. Now we are over them .” — Prashant Rao
